text: 中国9月CPI同比0.9%，同比涨幅为三个月高点，前值为0.8%。 中国9月PPI同比5.0%，同比涨幅为2022年6月以来最高，预估为4.4%，前值为3.8%。
text_en: China's September CPI was 0.9% year-on-year, the highest year-on-year increase in three months, compared with 0.8% previously. China's September PPI was 5.0% year-on-year, the highest year-on-year increase since June 2022, compared with an estimate of 4.4% and 3.8% previously.
